objectives.en: Talk to the doctor and buy medicine

title.pt: Expressões de Saúde com Estar e Sentir
title.en: Health Expressions with Estar and Sentir
title.ar: تعبيرات الصحة مع estar و sentir

explanation.pt: Para falar de saúde: 'Estou doente' (I am sick), 'Estou com dor de cabeça' (I have a headache), 'Estou com febre' (I have a fever), 'Me sinto cansado' (I feel tired), 'Estou com gripe' (I have the flu). A dor é localizada: dor de cabeça, dor de barriga, dor de garganta.
explanation.en: To talk about health: 'Estou doente' (I am sick), 'Estou com dor de cabeça' (I have a headache), 'Estou com febre' (I have a fever), 'Me sinto cansado' (I feel tired), 'Estou com gripe' (I have the flu). The pain is located: dor de cabeça (headache), dor de barriga (stomachache), dor de garganta (sore throat).
explanation.ar: للتحدث عن الصحة: 'Estou doente' (أنا مريض)، 'Estou com dor de cabeça' (أعاني من صداع)، 'Estou com febre' (لدي حمى)، 'Me sinto cansado' (أشعر بالتعب)، 'Estou com gripe' (لدي إنفلونزا). الألم محدد بالموقع: dor de cabeça (صداع)، dor de barriga (ألم في البطن)، dor de garganta (التهاب في الحلق).

examples.pt: Ela está com febre desde ontem.
examples.en: She has had a fever since yesterday.
examples.ar: إنها تعاني من الحمى منذ الأمس.

explanation.pt: Para obrigação: 'ter que/ter de + infinitivo': 'Tenho que descansar' (I have to rest). Para conselho: 'dever + infinitivo': 'Você deve beber muita água' (You should drink a lot of water), 'Deve ir ao médico' (You should go to the doctor).
explanation.en: For obligation: 'ter que/ter de + infinitive': 'Tenho que descansar' (I have to rest). For advice: 'dever + infinitive': 'Você deve beber muita água' (You should drink a lot of water), 'Deve ir ao médico' (You should go to the doctor).
explanation.ar: للتعبير عن الواجب: 'ter que/ter de + صيغة المصدر': 'Tenho que descansar' (يجب أن أستريح). للنصيحة: 'dever + صيغة المصدر': 'Você deve beber muita água' (يجب أن تشرب الكثير من الماء)، 'Deve ir ao médico' (يجب أن تذهب إلى الطبيب).

examples.pt: Você tem que tomar o remédio.
examples.en: You have to take the medicine.
She should rest for two days.
I need to book an appointment.

reading.text_pt: Carlos acordou com dor de cabeça e dor de garganta. Ele está com febre, então foi ao médico. O médico receitou um remédio e disse que ele deve beber muita água e descansar. Carlos vai ficar em casa dois dias e espera melhorar logo.
reading.text_en: Carlos woke up with a headache and a sore throat. He has a fever, so he went to the doctor. The doctor prescribed a medicine and said he should drink a lot of water and rest. Carlos is going to stay home for two days and hopes to get better soon.
reading.text_ar: استيقظ كارلوس وهو يعاني من صداع والتهاب في الحلق. إنه يعاني من حمى، لذا ذهب إلى الطبيب. وصف له الطبيب دواءً وقال إنه يجب أن يشرب الكثير من الماء ويستريح. سيبقى كارلوس في المنزل لمدة يومين ويأمل أن يتحسن سريعًا.
